verdict.rationale: Omnirush is a desktop coding-agent app, and such a product could plausibly expose a public API, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a public API for driving the product programmatically. Bring-your-own provider keys, MCP server plugins, and a launch flag for the password store are client-side or adjacent features, not a public API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
